scope: One certified finite-precision local draw; NOT a complete epsilon-W1 sampler

native_certificate.method: Exact Gram inverse and symmetric Gershgorin bound on Mp

seed_generation.engine: random.Random MT19937, deterministic reproducibility tape only
seed_generation.scope: Each inverse-CDF cell is certified. Independence/uniformity is conditional on an ideal bit source; this replay is pseudorandom. No global bad-event or W1 budget is implemented.

proposal.scope: Proposal is rounded. A global propagation bound from ideal seeds through H factor, V and lambda is not allocated.

acceptance.scope: Decision agrees for every U in this dyadic cell, at the rational rounded lambda. No bound is asserted for replacing the ideal unrounded proposal.
